run_MRPCEval: run the MRPCEval class to compute sentence embeddings and evaluate paraphrase detection accuracy
loadFile_MRPC: load the MRPC dataset from a TSV file path and return sentence pairs with labels
create_MRPCEval_instance: create an MRPCEval instance with a task path and random seed for MRPC evaluation
do_prepare_MRPC: prepare MRPC sentence samples for embedding using a batcher and parameter configuration
test_MRPCEval_run: test the MRPCEval run method to evaluate paraphrase detection with dev and test accuracy metrics
